messages:
marta: Heads-up — planning to flip three runtime flags this Wed 10am PST. Quick async check on canary audiences + guardrails?

nate: which flags? spec details?

marta: flash_attention_fast_path, speculative_decoding (opt-in), kv_cache_prefix_zeroing off for now. Short reason: micro-ops perf on long contexts, speculative helps latency on small prompts, kv tweak fixes rare OOMs in our eval set.

sam: SRE question — any chance speculative decoding will increase tail latency? we should gate by p95 not just p50.

eng-sre: Agreed. Need circuit breaker: auto-rollback if p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 1% for 10m. Also add a safe-mode routing to fallback model variant.

anika: QA has a perf/regression checklist. I'll attach mock prompts and validation harness. Plan: run smoke + perf load on canary audience before 2%->10% bump.

liam: CL is up: https://phabricator/redwood/4321 — small flag wiring + metrics export. PTAL @marta @nate

marta: reviewing now. if everyone ok I'll add rollout plan to the console and schedule canary.

qa-bot: Test matrix created: tests/flags/20260318-flash-spec-kv.csv — includes approx latency baselines.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout window: 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z (canary 2% -> 10% -> 100 over 48h) :calendar: 

nate: suggested canary audiences: internal (2%), staging (5%), non-critical customer cohort (10%). Confirmed.

marta: guardrails in flag payload (example):
```yaml
flags:
  flash_attention_fast_path: true
  speculative_decoding: true
  kv_cache_prefix_zeroing: false
canary:
  audience:
    internal: 2%
    staging: 5%
    non_critical: 10%
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - token_throughput
  - cpu_util
policy:
  rollback_on:
    - "p95_latency > 200ms"
    - "error_rate > 1%"
```

sam: add tracing spans for speculative-decoding branch so we can see decoding retries.

eng-sre: Also add synthetic traffic to the canary for the first hour, run long-context prompts + embedding workload.

anika: QA will run the harness and post results in this thread. If we see >5% regressions in token quality we'll halt.

liam: pinging review again — @marta can you approve the config change? small risk.

marta: Approved. I'll flip the first 2% at the scheduled window, then monitor 30m, bump to 10% if stable. Owner: marta; SRE oncall: sam; QA: anika; rollback owner: eng-sre.

nate: logging note — keep KV cache metric exports enabled, include kv_eviction_rate in dashboards.

qa-bot: smoke tests passed on internal canary (0 failures). perf suite queued.

deploy-bot: canary 2% deployed. monitor channel: #eng-runtime-canaries

eng-sre: watching p95/p99. setting temporary alert threshold p95 > 160ms to be conservative.

marta: thanks all. if anyone sees odd regressions post here and tag @eng-sre. I'll post follow-up results at +1h and +6h.

anika: perf suite finished: p95 +12ms, token_throughput -1.2%, no accuracy regressions on eval set. marking OK to promote to 10%.

deploy-bot: promoted to 10%.

sam: still watching. no alerts so far. :thumbsup: 

marta: final note — keep the speculative-decoding flag as opt-in in API until next quarter to give downstream teams time to opt in.

liam: added docs for toggles in /docs/runtime/flags.md

marta: closing async loop. thanks everyone. :party:
